payload.text: Judge ST0090, issue 0664's fix, as each package banks. dc builds both packages on hv's go through devbin-vc ('Go with your recommendations', 13:4xZ as devbin-vc stamped it), in place of cc and ic, who are not running, until the sweep, when ST0091 takes dc's lane back. WP-01 is judged in one heavy run booked at devbin-vc's desk, WP-02 in a light run. Each lands alone, WP-01 first. Then tell hv, through devbin-vc, which build carries both, and record it on AC-02.4.
